description: Monthly payment, total interest, total paid and payoff month for a fixed-rate loan or mortgage, with an optional extra monthly payment (shows interest saved and how much sooner it ends) and an amortization schedule by year or by month (or none). Maths is in whole cents like the website; the last payment absorbs the rounding so the balance ends at 0. Rate 0–100 %, term 1 month to 100 years. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/loan-calc/

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5. 0 is allowed.

extraMonthly.description: Optional extra principal paid every month.

schedule.description: Amortization table: per calendar year, per month, or omit it.

startMonth.description: First payment month "YYYY-MM". Default: next month.

term.description: Loan term, in years (default) or months (see termUnit).

name: calc_loan
title: Loan / mortgage calculator
